comparison.objective: Reattach a detached wrist camera to its mount and restore live sensing.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick up, align, insert, seat, and latch a camera into a constrained wrist channel.
comparison.success_condition: Camera is latched within pose tolerances, delivers a live frame, remains stable after release, and is not dropped.
comparison.reason: Precision insertion and latching overlap only generically with alignment; the candidate centrally tests controlled tang fracture and recovery of four free fragments.
